summary: Round-2 re-review of 17-funnel-multi-entry Testing Strategy. All four round-1 medium findings are now resolved with named, behavioral test scenarios; the round-1 lows (component spec owner, i18n parity owner, intra-vs-cross on_start 422 split) are also resolved. The plan now names the core 'one execution' invariant as a no-second-row IT, the self-loop termination as a regression IT, the CAS-loss IT as a state-integrity+WARN assertion, and a cross-funnel isolation IT. Two residual minor watch-items remain (i18n assertion shape, multi-funnel fan-out dispatch case) but neither is a blocking coverage gap. Pyramid is healthy (unit + slow-lane IT, no E2E, correct for API/Backend).

findings.location: Section: Testing Strategy / Frontend (line 224); AC line 274
findings.issue: i18n uk/en parity now has a named owner ('asserted (no empty keys) in the component spec'), which resolves the round-1 ownership gap. Residual nuance: the spec does not state HOW parity is asserted. A component spec that renders the Triggers panel in a single active locale will not catch a key present in en but missing/empty in uk (or vice versa) unless it explicitly diffs the two locale key sets. Round-1 finding is downgraded to minor, not fully closed.
findings.recommendation: Specify the assertion mechanism: either (a) a key-set diff test that fails if any Triggers-panel label key exists in en.json but is missing/empty in uk.json (and reverse), or (b) render the panel twice (uk and en) and assert every visible label is non-empty and not equal to its raw i18n key. Asserting in only one locale is insufficient.

findings.location: Section: Testing Strategy / Integration tests (line 220-223); How it works step 1-3 (fan-out)
findings.issue: Cross-funnel isolation is now covered for the single-other-funnel case ('event firing while in-flight in a different funnel STARTs the trigger's funnel and leaves the other untouched') — round-1 M4 resolved. Residual: the fan-out boundary where ONE event matches TWO active funnels at once (redirect for the funnel the subscriber is in-flight in, start for the other) is part of the same correctness surface (How it works step 1 LIST-queries all matching funnels; Decision 11 centralizes per-funnel evaluation) but is not named as a distinct scenario. The matched-element re-scan unit test (line 216) covers element selection within ONE funnel, not independent per-funnel dispatch on a multi-match.
findings.recommendation: Add to EventsControllerIT or FunnelEventServiceTest: subscriber in-flight in funnel A; event E has matching event triggers in BOTH A and B; assert A is REDIRECTED to its trigger entryStepId and B gets a FRESH execution started at B.entryStepId, each evaluated independently in the same dispatch. Asserts the fan-out loop applies the redirect-vs-start decision per matched funnel rather than once globally.
